name: launchly
description: Self-hosted deployment and testing collaboration platform.

scripts.test: pnpm test:policy && pnpm --dir services/api test && pnpm test:api:e2e && pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir cli test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm test:policy && pnpm --dir services/api test:coverage && pnpm --dir apps/web test:coverage && pnpm --dir cli test:coverage
scripts.quality: pnpm test:policy && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
